name: Crowdin
description: Crowdin localization on crowdin.com and Crowdin Enterprise: projects and progress, files, source strings, translations and approvals, comments, tasks, reports, translation builds and exports, translation memories, glossaries and members. Crowdin API v2 with a personal access token.
instructions:
## Crowdin
This connector works with the **Crowdin API v2** on crowdin.com (`https://api.crowdin.com/api/v2`) and on **Crowdin Enterprise** (`https://<organization>.api.crowdin.com/api/v2`): projects and progress, files, source strings, translations and approvals, comments and issues, tasks, reports, translation builds and exports, translation memories, glossaries and project members. Crowdin also runs an official MCP server (`https://mcp.crowdin.com/v2/mcp`, Enterprise `https://<organization>.mcp.crowdin.com/v2/mcp`, personal access token as Bearer).

**Setup (2 minutes)**
1. crowdin.com: **Account Settings > API > New Token**. Crowdin Enterprise: **profile > Settings > API > New Token** inside your organization. Pick the scopes you need (Projects, Source files and strings, Translations, Tasks, Reports, Translation memory, Glossaries; read-only scopes for a read-only setup). Copy the token: it is shown once.
2. Paste it into `CROWDIN_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN`; it is sent as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.
3. `CROWDIN_API_HOST`: `api.crowdin.com` for crowdin.com, or `<organization>.api.crowdin.com` for Enterprise (the organization domain from your Enterprise URL `https://<organization>.crowdin.com`).
4. Run `crowdin_get_authenticated_user` to check both.

**Workflow**
- Overview: `crowdin_list_projects`, `crowdin_get_project`, `crowdin_get_project_progress` (per language), `crowdin_get_file_progress`, `crowdin_list_supported_languages` for language ids.
- Structure: `crowdin_list_branches`, `crowdin_list_directories`, `crowdin_list_files`, `crowdin_get_file`, `crowdin_download_file` (link to the source file).
- Strings: `crowdin_list_strings` (by file, label, task, text or CroQL), `crowdin_get_string`, `crowdin_add_string`, `crowdin_edit_string` (JSON Patch on `/text`, `/context`, `/identifier`, ...).
- Translations: `crowdin_list_translations` (one language at a time), `crowdin_get_translation`, `crowdin_add_translation`, `crowdin_list_approvals`, `crowdin_approve_translation`.
- Discussion: `crowdin_list_comments` (comments and issues, e.g. unresolved context requests), `crowdin_add_comment`.
- Tasks: `crowdin_list_tasks`, `crowdin_get_task`, `crowdin_create_task` (translate or proofread for files and a language; on Enterprise use `workflow_step_id`), `crowdin_edit_task` (JSON Patch, e.g. `/status` to `done`).
- Reports (asynchronous): `crowdin_generate_report` returns `data.identifier`; poll `crowdin_get_report_status` until `status` is `finished`, then `crowdin_download_report` for the link.
- Translated files: `crowdin_export_project_translation` gives one language as one file at once; `crowdin_build_project_translations` builds every file and language as a zip: poll `crowdin_get_build_status`, then `crowdin_download_build`. Download links expire after a short time (`expireIn`): hand them to the user rather than storing them.
- Translation memory: `crowdin_list_tms`, `crowdin_get_tm`, `crowdin_list_tm_segments`, `crowdin_search_tm` (how a phrase was translated before), `crowdin_add_tm_segment`.
- Glossaries: `crowdin_list_glossaries`, `crowdin_get_glossary`, `crowdin_list_glossary_terms`, `crowdin_add_glossary_term`.
- People: `crowdin_list_members`, `crowdin_get_member`.

**Ids and values**: project, file, string, translation, task and user ids are numbers; report identifiers are strings. Languages use Crowdin ids such as `de`, `fr`, `es-ES`, `pt-BR`, `zh-CN`. Times are ISO 8601 with offset. PATCH tools take JSON Patch lists: `[{"op": "replace", "path": "/status", "value": "done"}]`.

**Reading the answers**: lists come as `{"data": [{"data": {...}}, ...], "pagination": {"offset": 0, "limit": 25}}`; single items as `{"data": {...}}`. Progress numbers are in `words` and `phrases` with `translationProgress` and `approvalProgress` in percent.

**Paging**: `limit` (25 by default, 500 at most) and `offset`. When a page holds `limit` items, ask for the next with `offset + limit`.

**Limits and errors**: 20 simultaneous requests per account, across all its tokens, on crowdin.com and Enterprise; 429 means wait. 401 is a wrong or expired token or the wrong host, 403 a token without the scope or project rights, 404 an unknown id, 400 and 422 a validation error naming the field. There are no delete tools.
prerequisites: A crowdin.com or Crowdin Enterprise account and a personal access token with the scopes you need.

CROWDIN_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN.label: Personal access token
CROWDIN_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN.help: crowdin.com: Account Settings > API > New Token. Enterprise: profile > Settings > API > New Token. Pick the scopes the connector needs; the token is shown once.
CROWDIN_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN.patternMessage: Paste only the token, without spaces, quotes or a Bearer prefix.

CROWDIN_API_HOST.label: API host
CROWDIN_API_HOST.help: api.crowdin.com for crowdin.com; <organization>.api.crowdin.com for Crowdin Enterprise (the organization from https://<organization>.crowdin.com).
CROWDIN_API_HOST.patternMessage: Enter only the host: api.crowdin.com, or <organization>.api.crowdin.com for Enterprise.

verifyHints.401: Crowdin refused the token. Check it, and that CROWDIN_API_HOST matches: api.crowdin.com for crowdin.com, <organization>.api.crowdin.com for Enterprise.
verifyHints.403: The token lacks a scope or the account lacks rights in this project. Create a token with the scopes the tools need.
verifyHints.rate_limited: Crowdin limits simultaneous requests per account. Wait a moment and try again.

tools.name: crowdin_get_authenticated_user
tools.description: The user the token belongs to: id, username, email, name and time zone. Use it to check the token.

tools.name: crowdin_list_projects
tools.description: Projects the token can reach, with id, name, identifier, source language, target language ids, type (file-based or string-based) and last activity.

filter.description: Text to match in the project name or identifier.

order_by.description: Sort, e.g. name asc or lastActivity desc.

tools.name: crowdin_get_project
tools.description: One project with its settings: source language, target languages, workflow, QA checks, machine translation and translation memory settings.

tools.name: crowdin_get_project_progress
tools.description: Translation and approval progress per target language: words and phrases total, translated, approved, and the percentages.

language_ids.description: Comma-separated language ids to limit the answer.

tools.name: crowdin_get_file_progress
tools.description: Translation and approval progress of one file per target language.

tools.name: crowdin_list_supported_languages
tools.description: Every language Crowdin supports with its id (used everywhere else), name, locale, ISO codes and plural categories.

tools.name: crowdin_list_branches
tools.description: Branches of a project (file-based projects) with id, name, title and export pattern.

name.description: Only the branch with this name.

tools.name: crowdin_list_directories
tools.description: Directories of a project with id, name, path, branch and parent directory.

tools.name: crowdin_list_files
tools.description: Source files of a project with id, name, path, type, status, branch, directory and revision.

filter.description: Text to match in file names.

recursion.description: 1 to include files in nested directories.

tools.name: crowdin_get_file
tools.description: One source file with its path, type, parser settings, export options, revision and timestamps.

tools.name: crowdin_download_file
tools.description: A short-lived download link (data.url, data.expireIn) for the source version of a file.

tools.name: crowdin_list_strings
tools.description: Source strings of a project with id, identifier (key), text, context, file, max length, labels, plural forms and hidden flag. Filter by file, branch, directory, label, task, a text match or a CroQL expression.

filter.description: Text to match in identifier, text or context.

scope.description: Where filter looks, comma-separated: identifier, text, context.

croql.description: CroQL filter, e.g. count of translations where (language = @language:"de") = 0. Combines only with order_by, offset and limit.

denormalize_placeholders.description: 1 to show placeholders in their original format.

order_by.description: Sort, e.g. createdAt desc or identifier asc.

tools.name: crowdin_get_string
tools.description: One source string with identifier, text, context, plural forms, labels, max length and file.

tools.name: crowdin_add_string
tools.description: Add a source string to a file (file-based projects) with its text, key and context for translators.

file_id.description: File id to add the string to.

tools.name: crowdin_edit_string
tools.description: Change a source string with JSON Patch operations on /text, /identifier, /context, /isHidden, /maxLength or /labelIds. update_option says what happens to existing translations when the text changes.

operations.description: JSON Patch operations, e.g. [{"op": "replace", "path": "/context", "value": "Button on the cart page"}].

update_option.description: For a text change: keep translations and approvals, keep translations only, or clear both.

tools.name: crowdin_list_translations
tools.description: All translations (suggestions) of strings into one language, with text, author, rating, plural category and time. Filter by string or file.

language_id.description: Crowdin language id, e.g. de, fr, es-ES, pt-BR (from crowdin_list_supported_languages or the project's targetLanguageIds).

file_id.description: Only translations of strings in this file.

denormalize_placeholders.description: 1 to show placeholders in their original format.

order_by.description: Sort, e.g. rating desc or createdAt desc.

tools.name: crowdin_get_translation
tools.description: One translation with its text, string, language, author, rating and provider.

tools.name: crowdin_add_translation
tools.description: Add a translation (suggestion) for a string in one language. A proofreader or crowdin_approve_translation then approves it.

language_id.description: Crowdin language id, e.g. de, fr, es-ES, pt-BR (from crowdin_list_supported_languages or the project's targetLanguageIds).

plural_category_name.description: For plural strings: zero, one, two, few, many or other.

add_to_tm.description: Also save it to the translation memory (default true).

tools.name: crowdin_list_approvals
tools.description: Approvals of translations, filtered by string, file, language, label or translation, with the approver and time.

language_id.description: Crowdin language id, e.g. de, fr, es-ES, pt-BR (from crowdin_list_supported_languages or the project's targetLanguageIds).

tools.name: crowdin_approve_translation
tools.description: Approve a translation, making it the one that goes into the exported files. Needs proofreader rights for its language.

tools.name: crowdin_list_comments
tools.description: Comments and issues on strings: text, type (comment or issue), issue type and status, language, author and time.

tools.name: crowdin_add_comment
tools.description: Comment on a string, or report an issue (a question, a translation or source mistake, a request for context).

target_language_id.description: Language id the comment is about, e.g. de.

tools.name: crowdin_list_tasks
tools.description: Tasks of a project with title, type (translate or proofread), status, language, assignees, progress, deadline and words count.

status.description: Comma-separated statuses: todo, in_progress, done, closed (Enterprise also review).

assignee_id.description: Only tasks assigned to this user id (crowdin.com).

tools.name: crowdin_get_task
tools.description: One task with its files or strings, language, assignees, progress, deadline, cost estimate and status.

tools.name: crowdin_create_task
tools.description: Create a translate or proofread task for files (or, in string-based projects, strings) in one language, assigned to people, with a deadline. In Crowdin Enterprise pass workflow_step_id instead of type.

language_id.description: Crowdin language id, e.g. de, fr, es-ES, pt-BR (from crowdin_list_supported_languages or the project's targetLanguageIds).

workflow_step_id.description: Crowdin Enterprise: the workflow step id.

assignees.description: Assignees, e.g. [{"id": 12345}] or with wordsCount to split the work.

skip_assigned_strings.description: Leave out strings already in other tasks.

tools.name: crowdin_edit_task
tools.description: Change a task with JSON Patch operations, e.g. its status (todo, in_progress, done, closed), title, description, deadline or assignees.

tools.name: crowdin_generate_report
tools.description: Start a project report: costs estimate, translation costs, top members, contribution raw data, translator accuracy, QA issues, translation activity and more. Returns an identifier: check crowdin_get_report_status until finished, then crowdin_download_report. Read-only for the project, although it is a POST.

schema.description: Report settings, e.g. {"unit": "words", "format": "xlsx", "dateFrom": "2026-10-01T00:00:00+00:00", "dateTo": "2026-10-31T23:59:59+00:00", "languageId": "de"}. Formats: xlsx, csv, json. Cost reports also take currency and baseRates.

tools.name: crowdin_get_report_status
tools.description: Progress of a report being generated: status (created, inProgress, finished, failed) and progress percent.

tools.name: crowdin_download_report
tools.description: A short-lived download link (data.url) for a finished report.

tools.name: crowdin_build_project_translations
tools.description: Start a build of the translated files of a project (all or some languages, optionally a branch) as a zip. Returns a build id: poll crowdin_get_build_status, then crowdin_download_build. Read-only for the content, although it is a POST.

target_language_ids.description: Only these language ids; empty for all.

skip_untranslated_files.description: Leave files that are not fully translated out.

export_approved_only.description: Only approved translations (crowdin.com; Enterprise exports by workflow).

tools.name: crowdin_get_build_status
tools.description: Status and progress of a translations build (created, inProgress, finished, failed, canceled).

tools.name: crowdin_download_build
tools.description: A short-lived download link (data.url) for the zip of a finished build.

tools.name: crowdin_export_project_translation
tools.description: Export the translations of one language right away, as one file in a chosen format (e.g. xliff, json, android, macosx), for all or some files. Returns a short-lived download link. Read-only although it is a POST.

target_language_id.description: Crowdin language id, e.g. de, fr, es-ES, pt-BR (from crowdin_list_supported_languages or the project's targetLanguageIds).

format.description: Export format, e.g. xliff, crowdin-json, android, macosx, gettext, yaml.

export_approved_only.description: Only approved translations (crowdin.com; Enterprise exports by workflow).

tools.name: crowdin_list_tms
tools.description: Translation memories with id, name, languages, segments count and the projects using them.

filter.description: Text to match in the name.

tools.name: crowdin_get_tm
tools.description: One translation memory with its languages, segments count and default project.

tools.name: crowdin_list_tm_segments
tools.description: Segments of a translation memory, each with its records (language id and text). Filter with CroQL.

tools.name: crowdin_search_tm
tools.description: Concordance search: find how phrases were translated before in the translation memories of a project. Read-only although it is a POST.

target_language_id.description: Crowdin language id, e.g. de, fr, es-ES, pt-BR (from crowdin_list_supported_languages or the project's targetLanguageIds).

tools.name: crowdin_add_tm_segment
tools.description: Add a segment to a translation memory: the same sentence in several languages.

records.description: Records, e.g. [{"languageId": "en", "text": "Add to cart"}, {"languageId": "de", "text": "In den Warenkorb"}].

tools.name: crowdin_list_glossaries
tools.description: Glossaries with id, name, languages, terms count and the projects using them.

filter.description: Text to match in the name.

tools.name: crowdin_get_glossary
tools.description: One glossary with its languages, terms count and default project.

tools.name: crowdin_list_glossary_terms
tools.description: Terms of a glossary with text, language, description, part of speech, status, type, note and concept id (terms of one concept are translations of each other).

tools.name: crowdin_add_glossary_term
tools.description: Add a term to a glossary, optionally as the translation of an existing term (translation_of_term_id) or into a concept.

part_of_speech.description: Part of speech, e.g. noun, verb, adjective, proper noun.

translation_of_term_id.description: Id of the term this one translates.

concept_id.description: Concept to add the term to.

tools.name: crowdin_list_members
tools.description: Members of a project with id, username, full name, role (manager, proofreader, translator, ...) and their languages.

search.description: Text to match in username or name.

language_id.description: Only members working on this language.

tools.name: crowdin_get_member
tools.description: One project member with role, permissions per language and join date.
